medium.title: Six accepted Potion Rush usage links retain a non-resolving predecessor ledger path
medium.context: Six records exactly preserve a Phase 4 normalized source_artifact path under measure/tracks after the T6 predecessor moved to measure/archive. The normalizer and archive-equivalent bytes resolve and the archive bytes match SHA-256 4183d051..., but the published nested locator itself is absent. The live Phase 5 contract remains green because it does not recursively resolve normalized predecessor paths and JSON pointers.
required_remediation: Publish a durable relocation resolver or regenerate the T5-T7 normalizer, affected Phase 4 joins, and Phase 5 report/manifest so every nested predecessor path and JSON pointer resolves while retaining the exact accepted hash.
Add a hash-bound Phase 5 negative fixture and recursive contract assertion for missing nested predecessor paths, including the archive-move case.
Rerun producer, truth contract, fresh slice/global independent review, and root acceptance against remediated hashes.
medium.acceptance_impact: Blocks a clean slice pass, global Phase 5 acceptance, and accepted-manifest publication.
medium.global_scope_disclosure: Root reports this defect class currently spans 37 records and three missing ledgers globally; this slice independently reviewed only the six records listed here.

otherwise_passing_checks: 143/143 report records and manifest entries exactly match source objects and record hashes.
150/150 caller locators resolve to exact Git-pinned lines, hashes, literals, inventory pointers, and path ownership.
24/24 usage links and 84/84 responsive cells match Phase 4; all semantic roles/states remain null pending T9.
143/143 provenance/license envelopes are explicit unknown; reuse/adapt/reference are all false.
143/143 canonical T9 keys are null and direct legacy adoption is false.
202/202 source bindings and 18/18 fixtures match exact bytes.

explicit_path_coverage_proof.rule: One entry per assigned report record; no sampling.

substantive_inspection_coverage.rule: Every inspection object, member path, source manifest, exact Git blob, classification record, and primary working-note observation was reviewed.

direct_visual.method: Four contact sheets from exact frozen blobs, including both SVGs and a sampled WebM frame.

guard_and_truth_test_verification.browser_scope: Composite-scene only; per-path runtime load remains not_established in all 84 cells.

live_contract_test.blind_spot: Does not recursively require normalized predecessor locators to resolve.

supersession_requirement: This artifact records the pre-repair observation. A later path restoration does not retroactively change this decision; a fresh independent review bound to the repaired exact hashes must publish a superseding review.
